# Intentionally public names in this repository (leak-guard suppresses a finding
# when a line below matches its text OR its repository-relative path).
#
# This repository IS the deployment configuration and is public on purpose
# (on-prem plan): the rendered manifests, per-product values, platform
# manifests and the Helm chart carry the real hostnames, addresses and — path-
# allowlisted, never written here — the org identifiers that are already part
# of the public deployment. Path entries (not value entries) for those: an
# allowlist line is itself public, so an identifier literal must never be one.
^rendered/
^values/
^platform/
^charts/
^\.gitleaks\.toml$
^\.github/workflows/chart-release\.yaml$
